title_zh: 十年一日：从面向人类的软件演化中合成智能体原生接口
one_line: Synthesises agent-native atomic and goal-level commands from desktop app SDKs; artifact-verified tasks show higher success and ~73% fewer tokens than native SDK.
one_line_zh: 从桌面应用SDK合成智能体原生命令接口，在产物校验任务上成功率高于原生SDK且token减少约73%。

online_eval.quote: Each task carries a script verifier, which inspects the artifact the agent saved and returns pass or fail through deterministic checks.

held_out_env.quote: We partition the 368 tasks across eight applications into training and test sets at an approximately 7:3 ratio within each application, yielding 258 training tasks and 110 held-out test tasks in total.

variance.quote: each task is attempted independently three times from the same initial state and counts as successful if at least one attempt passes its artifact verifier

strong_baselines.quote: keeping the remaining settings of Section 5.3 fixed: the same scaffold, the same 368 tasks, and the same generated interfaces for CLI-Anything and ANIS

budget_matched.quote: we vary only the installed application release while holding the task, seed files, agent scaffold, tool permissions, time budget, and verifier fixed across releases.

cost_reported.quote: atomic interfaces improve success over native SDK use by 3.8 and 3.5 percentage points with DeepSeek V4 Flash and Claude Haiku 4.5, respectively, while reducing online token usage by approximately 73%.

component_ablation.quote: Table 5 shows that prohibiting observation reduces overall success from 72.3% to 60.3%, a drop of 12.0 percentage points.

validator_check.quote: We validate each verifier by confirming that it accepts the reference artifact and rejects task-relevant perturbations that violate the required output conditions.

code.quote: The code, DeskIF-Bench tasks with their verifiers, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/co-evolve-lab/ANIS .

evidence_level.quote: On an expanded evaluation of 368 tasks across eight applications, atomic interfaces improve success over native SDK use by 3.8 and 3.5 percentage points

S5.quote: ANIS delivers all three for any installed application, without waiting for it to evolve, by synthesizing its runtime capabilities into commands validated by the application itself and extending them with goal-level commands mined from use.

AP5.quote: The main evaluation synthesizes goal-level commands from prior task trajectories and evaluates the augmented interface on 368 tasks across eight applications

title_zh: Seg2Click：为GUI视觉定位学习像素级动作掩码
one_line: Replaces coordinate tokens with a box-supervised sub-token executable-region mask head; offline grounding gains over matched coordinate and GUI-Actor baselines.
one_line_zh: 以框监督的子token可执行区域掩码头替代坐标生成，在离线定位基准上优于同骨干坐标与GUI-Actor基线。

online_eval.quote: We report Hit@1: a prediction is correct when its single click lies inside the annotated target box, including its boundary.

strong_baselines.quote: With Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Seg2Click reaches 47.00% on ScreenSpot-Pro, exceeding published GUI-Actor with the same base checkpoint by 4.80 points and its verifier-assisted variant by 1.10 points.

budget_matched.quote: The coordinate-generation comparison shares the initialization, training data, LoRA configuration, optimizer arguments, and one-epoch schedule with Seg2Click.

cost_reported.quote: All models use a 1,024-channel decoder and are trained for one epoch on the same grounding data as GUI-Actor, comprising approximately 1M screenshots from six public GUI datasets

component_ablation.quote: Under matched training settings, Seg2Click improves over coordinate generation by 0.94, 1.02, and 1.52 points across the three benchmarks, adding 12, 13, and 24 correct clicks.

code.quote: Code will be available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click.

evidence_level.quote: We report Hit@1: a prediction is correct when its single click lies inside the annotated target box, including its boundary.

S1.quote: The largest margin occurs on ScreenSpot-Pro, highlighting its effectiveness in professional interfaces with small controls and dense layouts.

S2.quote: The coordinate-generation comparison shares the initialization, training data, LoRA configuration, optimizer arguments, and one-epoch schedule with Seg2Click.

S6.quote: Target bounding boxes provide supervision, and the centroid of the mask’s largest connected component determines the final click.

F6.quote: Building on these grounding results, future work will explore confidence-aware click selection and integration into interactive GUI agents

AP7.quote: We report Hit@1: a prediction is correct when its single click lies inside the annotated target box, including its boundary.

title_zh: HyWe：统一搜索与操作以完成真实世界混合网页任务
one_line: Unifies search tools and browser operation in one SFT-trained web agent with explicit mode switching; live-web gains on held-out sites, judged by LLM.
one_line_zh: 以显式模式切换统一搜索工具与浏览器操作并SFT训练，在训练外网站的在线混合任务上提升成功率（LLM评判）。

online_eval.quote: HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines

held_out_env.quote: To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training

strong_baselines.quote: HyWe-35B achieves 47.0\% success, versus 22.0\% for XYZ-Aquila-mini and 13.0\% for Fara-7B

budget_matched.quote: All systems share the same tasks, budget, and checklists, keeping evaluation fair across agent types.

cost_reported.quote: cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

component_ablation.quote: HyWe raises success from 11.0\% to 28.0\% . Information and operation completion rise from 36.9\% / 15.8\% to 74.8\% / 43.7\% .

validator_check.quote: An LLM judge verifies each item’s outcome from text observations and screenshots, regardless of the tools or mode used.

code.quote: We will release all code and research artifacts, including the framework, collection and evaluation pipelines

evidence_level.quote: We introduce HyWeBench to evaluate real-world hybrid task completion: 100 high-quality, human-written tasks on websites distinct from those used for training

S6.quote: The modes have complementary strengths (panel b): search-based mode completes more information sub-goals, and operation-based mode more operation sub-goals.

F6.quote: Before training, using both modes raises success only slightly over operation-based mode alone ( 28.0\% vs. 26.0\% ).

AP4.quote: An LLM judge verifies each item’s outcome from text observations and screenshots, regardless of the tools or mode used.

AP9.quote: Our ablations assess the framework as a whole, and the capability probe depends on its search tools and budget.

title_zh: PrivacyGuard：面向云端GUI智能体的源关联脱敏与本地可解析PII引用
one_line: Sanitises PII from uploaded instructions/screenshots and substitutes locally resolvable entity references; lowers LLM-audited leakage vs AbI while keeping AndroidLab success.
one_line_zh: 对上传指令与截图做源关联PII脱敏并以本地可解析引用替代，泄露低于AbI且保持AndroidLab任务成功率。

online_eval.quote: On the 138-task AndroidLab benchmark, PrivacyGuard achieves the highest or tied-highest task-success point estimate among protection pipelines for all four planners.

held_out_env.quote: External benchmarks and the independent multi-root generator provide evidence outside the controlled rendering process.

variance.quote: They quantify corpus- or task-resampling uncertainty rather than repeated hosted-model variability.

strong_baselines.quote: AbI is the closest prior full-pipeline comparator.

budget_matched.quote: All compared pipelines within each server-hosted experiment execute on the same RTX 4090 server to hold hardware placement constant.

cost_reported.quote: RQ4 measures latency, memory, and completion under device-resident execution.

component_ablation.quote: Removing shared adjudication reduces English-address GenR@1.0 by 0.5666.

validator_check.quote: CrossTurnPII and PrivScreen use two hosted readers from different model families, qwen3.7-plus ( Qwen ) and gemini-3-flash-preview ( Gemini ).

evidence_level.quote: On the 138-task AndroidLab benchmark, PrivacyGuard achieves the highest or tied-highest task-success point estimate among protection pipelines for all four planners.

S1.quote: Returned references are validated and resolved locally before the trusted executor receives the action payload.

S2.quote: On the 138-task AndroidLab benchmark, PrivacyGuard achieves the highest or tied-highest task-success point estimate among protection pipelines for all four planners.

S3.quote: CrossTurnPII includes released-view PII extraction, targeted single-reference reconstruction from Full, and targeted five-turn reconstruction from ordered Full uploads.

S4.quote: The evaluated Presidio AnalyzerEngine ( PrA ) and GLiNER detector exposed through Presidio’s recognizer interface ( PrG ) configurations render detected screenshot regions with an opaque fill

F6.quote: PrivacyGuard excludes client compromise, mediation bypass, side channels, availability attacks, and action-level misuse.

AP4.quote: CrossTurnPII and PrivScreen use two hosted readers from different model families, qwen3.7-plus ( Qwen ) and gemini-3-flash-preview ( Gemini ).

AP20.quote: Deliberate adaptive oracle probing that varies returned actions to infer local state from execution feedback is outside scope.

title_zh: 面向GUI智能体的自适应分组过程奖励
one_line: Partitions trajectories into subgoal groups for action- and group-level critic process rewards shaping GRPO; human-label reward benchmarks and OSWorld RL gains.
one_line_zh: 将轨迹划分为子目标组并在动作/组两级打过程奖励以塑形GRPO优势，奖励基准与OSWorld强化学习均提升。

online_eval.quote: OSWorld success is determined by execution-based scripts on the final desktop state; we report both a single-run success rate and the mean over three runs.

held_out_env.quote: we train and test on its Chrome, LibreOffice Impress, and LibreOffice Calc applications.

variance.quote: OSWorld success is determined by execution-based scripts on the final desktop state; we report both a single-run success rate and the mean over three runs.

strong_baselines.quote: For reinforcement learning on OSWorld, we compare against the base model, outcome-only GRPO Shao et al. (2024) , and SeekJudge as a process-reward alternative.

budget_matched.quote: Rollouts use N=8 trajectories per instruction, 15 concurrent environments, a maximum of 30 environment steps, and sampling temperature 0.7

cost_reported.quote: Sampling throughput under synchronous and asynchronous scoring is reported in Appendix B.1 .

component_ablation.quote: Single-group lowers overall accuracy to 75.7 , which shows that splitting the trajectory into subgoal groups is useful

validator_check.quote: CUARewardBench treats each step judgment as a binary decision against a human label.

evidence_level.quote: OSWorld success is determined by execution-based scripts on the final desktop state; we report both a single-run success rate and the mean over three runs.

S1.quote: our framework achieves the highest overall accuracy ( 81.3 ), 3.6 points above GPT-5 with OpenCUA-Reflector ( 77.7 )

S3.quote: We further use the generated process rewards to shape the GRPO Shao et al. (2024) advantage at each step, providing finer-grained credit assignment during policy optimization.

F2.quote: Our framework also achieves the highest recall ( 57.2 ), at lower precision ( 30.6 vs. 44.0 ), thus missing fewer error steps.

F4.quote: we train and test on its Chrome, LibreOffice Impress, and LibreOffice Calc applications.

AP4.quote: CUARewardBench treats each step judgment as a binary decision against a human label.

AP8.quote: we train and test on its Chrome, LibreOffice Impress, and LibreOffice Calc applications.

title_zh: MHVF：基于验证引导多假设搜索的免训练GUI定位
one_line: Training-free: samples multiple target hypotheses, zooms and re-grounds each, verifies marked crops with the same VLM; large offline ScreenSpot-Pro gains at higher token cost.
one_line_zh: 免训练地采样多个目标假设、放大重定位并用同一VLM验证标记裁剪，ScreenSpot-Pro等离线定位大幅提升但视觉token成本增加。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate MHVF using grounding accuracy: a prediction is correct if its coordinate falls within the annotated target region.

strong_baselines.quote: With Qwen2.5-VL-7B, MHVF achieves 53.6%, compared with the reported 40.9% of DRS-GUI, 44.0% of ZoomClick, and 52.8% of ZoomUI.

budget_matched.quote: At matched dataset-mean visual input costs of approximately 36.0k tokens, the control achieves 54.7%, compared with 66.6% for MHVF.

cost_reported.quote: relative to Self-Zoom, the mean cumulative visual token estimate increases from 10.1k to 53.0k on Mind2Web and from 6.3k to 36.0k on ScreenSpot-Pro.

component_ablation.quote: Comparing the two variants without reopening, verification raises accuracy over ranking by hypothesis weight from 78.9% to 79.7% on Mind2Web and from 61.9% to 65.5% and 45.7% to 50.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro.

validator_check.quote: The remaining gap between both-level coverage and final accuracy is 4.2–12.1 points across the two benchmarks.

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate MHVF using grounding accuracy: a prediction is correct if its coordinate falls within the annotated target region.

S1.quote: Qwen2.5-VL-7B improves from 23.6% to 53.6%, while UI-Venus-Ground-7B improves from 50.3% to 66.6%.

S3.quote: For both models, accuracy increases up to \kappa=4 and then decreases at \kappa=5 .

S4.quote: To resolve ambiguity among the resulting candidates, it verifies their agreement with the instruction in marked local views.

F3.quote: GTA1-7B decreases from 79.6% to 76.5% on MMBench-GUI L2.

F6.quote: We evaluate MHVF using grounding accuracy: a prediction is correct if its coordinate falls within the annotated target region.

AP7.quote: We evaluate MHVF using grounding accuracy: a prediction is correct if its coordinate falls within the annotated target region.

title_zh: 学会如何记忆：GUI智能体的记忆模态选择
one_line: Learned router picks text or image form of retrieved demonstration memory per step from actor hidden states; beats fixed-modality memory, mostly on offline step scores.
one_line_zh: 基于执行器隐状态训练路由器，逐步选择文本或图像形式的检索记忆，主要在离线步级指标上优于固定模态记忆。

online_eval.quote: AITW and LearnGUI use the official benchmark-provided step level action scores, whereas MobileMiniWoB++ reports task success rate.

held_out_env.quote: Because MobileMiniWoB++ does not provide official training or validation splits, we transfer the router trained on LearnGUI while keeping its weights fixed.

strong_baselines.quote: The memory-augmented group compares different augmentation strategies using the same frozen Qwen3.5-9B actor and evaluation protocol.

cost_reported.quote: SwitchMem achieves the highest action score while adding only modest latency.

component_ablation.quote: Figure 7(b) shows that SwitchMem outperforms ratio matched random routing at every evaluated intermediate Image selection rate.

code.quote: Code and project resources are available at https://txxnrd.github.io/switchmem

evidence_level.quote: Our online evaluation uses emulated environments rather than physical devices.

AP7.quote: AITW and LearnGUI use the official benchmark-provided step level action scores, whereas MobileMiniWoB++ reports task success rate.

AP8.quote: Our evaluation focuses on mobile GUI benchmarks centered on Android interfaces and controlled interaction settings.

title_zh: GroundGUI：基于高质量数据与蒸馏到强化学习的GUI定位
one_line: Builds a 633K-expression grounding dataset from structure and tutorial videos, trains an 8B grounder with SFT, self-distillation then RLOO; offline grounding gains.
one_line_zh: 从结构元数据与教程视频构建63万指代表达定位数据，经SFT、自蒸馏与RLOO训练8B定位模型，离线定位基准提升。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate GroundGUI on 5 representative GUI grounding benchmarks

strong_baselines.quote: To directly compare with other open-source datasets, we train Qwen3-VL-8B on previous state-of-the-art grounding datasets, including ScaleCUA and GroundCUA.

budget_matched.quote: all post-training variants start from the same SFT checkpoint and use the same post-training data, and the single-stage variants (+OPSD and +RLOO) are each trained for 2 epochs.

cost_reported.quote: SFT is performed on 4 B300 GPUs, using a global batch size of 32 and a learning rate of 1\times 10^{-6} .

component_ablation.quote: Adding OPSD to SFT improves average score by 1.1 points, indicating that OPSD tailored for grounding improves the model via on-policy token-level supervision.

validator_check.quote: we adopt Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) to judge whether the answer matches the instruction given the raw image and the bounding box crop.

code.quote: Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate GroundGUI on 5 representative GUI grounding benchmarks

S2.quote: It covers desktop, web, and mobile platforms, with image resolutions ranging from 0.1 to 8.3M pixels.

S3.quote: For desktop, Accessibility Trees (A11y Trees) provide interface layouts and UI element coordinates. Document Object Model (DOM) structures offer element information for web browsers.

AP4.quote: we adopt Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) to judge whether the answer matches the instruction given the raw image and the bounding box crop.

AP7.quote: We evaluate GroundGUI on 5 representative GUI grounding benchmarks

AP10.quote: If confidence falls below a threshold \tau=0.95 , the proposal is escalated to Claude Opus 5 for re-grounding.

title_zh: 以学生自身风格施教：面向网页智能体的黑盒教师蒸馏
one_line: Black-box teacher edits student failures from the first mistake in the student's style, trained with action-weighted loss and KL anchor; beats BC/GRPO, transfers live.
one_line_zh: 黑盒教师从首个错误处以学生风格改写失败轨迹，配合动作加权损失与KL锚训练，优于BC与GRPO并迁移到在线网页。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate on: (a) TimeWarp (TW) ( Ishmam and Marino, 2026 ) , a containerized web benchmark with websites from different eras of the internet, and (b) OnlineMind2Web (OM2W)

held_out_env.quote: The performance transfers to unseen versions and to the live web in the OnlineMind2Web benchmark.

variance.quote: The average results of three seeds are reported with the standard error.

strong_baselines.quote: On the TimeWarp benchmark, WebKD students gain about 5.5-10.7 pp over behavior cloning, outcome-reward RL, and teacher editing baselines.

component_ablation.quote: In-context student re-styling, as used by WebKD , stays closer to the student distribution and outperforms it by 8.1pp.

validator_check.quote: For each failed trajectory, the teacher first localizes the error to prevent editing the correct steps.

evidence_level.quote: The gains hold on unseen versions and transfer to the live web (RQ2).

S1.quote: WebKD starts from a student agent fine-tuned to replicate the teacher ( P1 ).

S2.quote: A role-asymmetric KL anchor allows the corrected action to move freely while keeping the reasoning near the student's prior.

S3.quote: Given a failed episode, the teacher finds the first point of mistake, and rewrites the student's reasoning traces, harness states, and actions from that point onward.

S4.quote: In the objective space, the reasoning is weighted by its contribution to the action.

F3.quote: The gains are mostly concentrated on the easy tasks, which have a shorter horizon.

F5.quote: For each failed trajectory, the teacher first localizes the error to prevent editing the correct steps.

AP4.quote: For each failed trajectory, the teacher first localizes the error to prevent editing the correct steps.

title_zh: 任务状态治理：面向可验证、可恢复GUI智能体执行的虚拟机
one_line: Represents tasks as desired/preserved/observed state contracts with an independent visual verifier and reversibility-aware rollback; small oracle-checked benchmark plus user study.
one_line_zh: 将任务表示为期望/保护/观测状态契约，配独立视觉验证器与可逆性感知回滚，在小规模oracle校验基准与用户研究中评估。

online_eval.quote: All conditions execute against identical hidden-oracle world contracts, ensuring that evaluation relies on external ground truth rather than agent self-reports.

strong_baselines.quote: All LLM roles in all conditions ran the same production model (GPT-5.6-sol) through the same internal inference endpoint, so condition differences reflect the interaction and runtime architecture rather than model choice.

budget_matched.quote: TaskVM consumed 19,960 seconds of wall time across 1,126 model calls, about 2.2 times the wall time of Direct-CUA

cost_reported.quote: TaskVM consumed 19,960 seconds of wall time across 1,126 model calls, about 2.2 times the wall time of Direct-CUA

component_ablation.quote: This cost distribution cannot be attributed solely to verification: state compilation, dynamic re-projection, and structured execution boundaries all contribute to the measured wall-time gap.

validator_check.quote: An independent visual verifier , architecturally separated from the executor, checks fresh observations against the contract

evidence_level.quote: All conditions execute against identical hidden-oracle world contracts, ensuring that evaluation relies on external ground truth rather than agent self-reports.

S4.quote: TaskVM restored the protected pre-state in 4 of 6 applicable trials, while Direct-CUA restored none of its 3 applicable trials and Planner-CUA none of its 5

F1.quote: An independent visual verifier , architecturally separated from the executor, checks fresh observations against the contract

F4.quote: This cost distribution cannot be attributed solely to verification: state compilation, dynamic re-projection, and structured execution boundaries all contribute to the measured wall-time gap.

AP4.quote: An independent visual verifier , architecturally separated from the executor, checks fresh observations against the contract

AP8.quote: The automated evaluation suite comprises 36 task instances spanning 12 structural task families derived from the TaskVM architectural contract, with three variants per family.
